# Engineering Invariants

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_invariants.py; do not edit. Edit invariants.json. -->

A project activates only the invariants its real capabilities require and
records each current rung using the enforcement ladder.

| # | Invariant | Activates when | Timing | Default rung | Normative owner | Consumers |
| -: | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **`canonical-authority`**: Every fact has one authoritative owner, and every semantic behavior has one canonical implementation path. | always | `ownership_declaration` | `owner` | `architecture-foundations` | `application-composition` |
| 2 | **`bounded-contracts`**: Modules expose small intentional contracts; storage, provider, and framework internals remain behind their owners. | a module or process boundary exists | `boundary_introduction` | `local_check` | `architecture-foundations` | `interfaces-and-events` |
| 3 | **`shared-semantics`**: Shared product semantics live below every UI, API, worker, assistant, and backend; differences live in adapters. | two surfaces implement the same product behavior | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `application-composition` | - |
| 4 | **`explicit-composition`**: Assembly occurs in an explicit composition root rather than ambient globals or route construction. | a system has replaceable dependencies or multiple adapters | `boundary_introduction` | `local_check` | `architecture-foundations` | `application-composition` |
| 5 | **`durable-admission`**: When accepted user intent must survive the caller, successful admission means that intent is already durable. | work may outlive a request, route, process, or device opportunity | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `durable-workflows` | - |
| 6 | **`normal-failure-semantics`**: Retries, duplicates, timeouts, cancellation, interruption, and process death are defined execution paths. | work crosses a temporal or process boundary | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `durable-workflows` | `interfaces-and-events` |
| 7 | **`committed-event-truth`**: Events come from committed facts; durable consumers use persisted delivery or recovery state, while ephemeral events only wake them. | events or notifications can affect correctness | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `interfaces-and-events` | `durable-workflows` |
| 8 | **`publication-classes`**: Material data, operation progress, operation terminal state, and connectivity or authentication are distinct publication classes. | events invalidate reads or update user-visible operation state | `boundary_introduction` | `local_check` | `interfaces-and-events` | `application-composition` |
| 9 | **`coalesced-bounded-work`**: Equivalent intent coalesces, and concurrency, memory, network, provider, and queue use are explicitly bounded. | work can repeat, fan out, or consume shared resources | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `durable-workflows` | `interfaces-and-events` |
| 10 | **`resource-admission-and-reclamation`**: Activities holding scarce runtime resources are admitted against protected reserves, have one owning lifecycle, and complete or cooperatively yield within a bounded deadline; required control-plane progress is never reclaimed for optional work. A safety/correctness-critical action cannot depend on an optional telemetry or audit effect, including contention that effect introduces. A mandatory audit has an explicit durability, capacity, and failure contract. | runtime activities contend for memory, buffers, peripherals, sockets, task capacity, locks, database connections, transactions, serialized queues, or another contention domain that can block required progress | `boundary_introduction` | `runtime_guard` | `architecture-foundations` | `durable-workflows`, `application-composition`, `verification-and-operations`, `security-assurance` |
| 11 | **`transient-presentation`**: Presentation owns rendering and transient interaction, not retries, synchronization, imports, provider polling, or durable workflow state. | an interactive client exists | `boundary_introduction` | `local_check` | `application-composition` | - |
| 12 | **`useful-paint-graph`**: Every important surface has an explicit useful-paint graph; optional enrichment loads and fails independently. | a user-visible surface performs asynchronous reads | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `application-composition` | - |
| 13 | **`persistence-qos`**: Interactive persistence receives priority, while noninteractive work is bounded, observable, and yields between committed units. | interactive and background work share a non-preemptible resource | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `durable-workflows` | `application-composition` |
| 14 | **`authority-context-fencing`**: Sensitive or authority-dependent operations bind principal/account, capability, purpose, consent, and lifecycle/expiry to one authorization context and fence reads, exports, commits, acknowledgments, and publication against its revocation or change. Possessing a credential, OS permission, or provider grant alone does not authorize its use for another principal, purpose, operation, or account. | authorization can change during synchronous or durable work, or sensitive data is accessed | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `interfaces-and-events` | `durable-workflows`, `data-and-compatibility`, `application-composition`, `security-assurance`, `privacy-assurance` |
| 15 | **`representation-separation`**: Source observations, canonical state, projections, caches, transport objects, and persisted records remain distinct representations with explicit owners. | one fact has more than one representation | `ownership_declaration` | `owner` | `data-and-compatibility` | `architecture-foundations` |
| 16 | **`explicit-deletion`**: Absence is not deletion; destruction requires an explicit lifecycle event such as a tombstone, erasure, or verified lossless migration. | state is synchronized, imported, repaired, migrated, expired, or erased | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `data-and-compatibility` | - |
| 17 | **`versioned-compatibility`**: Persistent, wire, event, storage, and worker contracts are versioned; temporary compatibility names consumers, proof, telemetry, and a removal gate. | independently deployed readers and writers coexist | `risk_proportional` | `ci_check` | `data-and-compatibility` | `verification-and-operations` |
| 18 | **`typed-boundaries`**: Identity, time, units, provenance, capability, and privacy are validated boundary types rather than conventions hidden in strings. | ambiguous primitives cross a trust or representation boundary | `boundary_introduction` | `local_check` | `interfaces-and-events` | `data-and-compatibility`, `application-composition` |
| 19 | **`discoverable-operations`**: Humans and agents use one discoverable operational interface; machine configuration is local and secrets remain in credential systems. | the repository has repeated build, test, migration, repair, or release actions | `boundary_introduction` | `ci_check` | `verification-and-operations` | - |
| 20 | **`separate-action-authority`**: Implementation, integration, metadata change, deployment, installation, migration, repair, and publication are distinct authorization scopes; one explicit instruction may authorize any named combination, while a narrower request never implies a broader action. | work can mutate shared or external state | `risk_proportional` | `runtime_guard` | `verification-and-operations` | - |
| 21 | **`typed-exact-evidence`**: Claims bind to exact revisions and evidence classes; generated, simulated, automated, physical, and production observations never substitute for one another. | a result gates integration, release, compatibility, safety, or physical behavior | `risk_proportional` | `ci_check` | `verification-and-operations` | `architecture-hardening`, `security-assurance`, `privacy-assurance` |
| 22 | **`privacy-lifecycle`**: Derived data, telemetry, logs, audits, caches, and artifacts inherit source sensitivity, purpose, retention, and erasure obligations unless a repository-authorized, evidence-backed exception proves otherwise. Erasure or expiry revokes future write authority as well as removing existing data; delayed work cannot recreate erased state. | sensitive data or its derivatives are collected, read, retained, exported, expired, or erased | `risk_proportional` | `fault_test` | `data-and-compatibility` | `interfaces-and-events`, `durable-workflows`, `application-composition`, `privacy-assurance` |
| 23 | **`open-world-assurance`**: Consequential modifications or new exposure of trust/authorization boundaries and changes to sensitive data collection, use, disclosure, derivation, retention, expiry, or erasure receive scoped assurance; preserving existing contracts alone does not require an independent reviewer. Explicit release assurance covers the candidate inventory beyond changed paths. An evidenced material defect can block acceptance without a pre-existing catalog invariant; review records the violated obligation, execution path, consequence, confidence, and coverage limits. | a consequential change alters trust/authorization or sensitive data lifecycle semantics, or changed-path/release-wide security/privacy assurance is requested | `risk_proportional` | `audit` | `verification-and-operations` | `security-assurance`, `privacy-assurance` |

`owner_skill` is the only normative interpreter of an invariant.
Consumers apply it without redefining it. Timing and default rung are
starting recommendations; the reviewed project profile records reality
and any authorized exception.
